Frank had the perfect opportunity to kill Charlie right before the report, and he deliberately hid the fact that he went into that room at the very end of the round. 

Since I'm the last speaker and we have a direct lie regarding the crime scene, I am voting for Frank. Everyone should follow me on this.

I just found Bob dead in weapons. 

I've been running a massive loop around the entire ship doing my tasks—electrical, security, navigation, storage, all the way across to oxygen and the engines, and then back through the cafeteria to weapons, which is where I found the body. 

Bob was alive relatively recently because I crossed paths with him in oxygen around tick 36. Eve, I saw you way earlier in security around tick 20, but I don't know where you went after that. Alice, I haven't seen you at all this entire round. 

Since it's just the three of us left (me, Alice, and Eve), one of you has to be the Duck. Alice, you're my biggest question mark right now since you've been a ghost to me. Please both of you state your paths so we can figure this out. This is make-or-break.

Diana, your timeline actually clears Eve completely and points directly to you. You claim you saw Bob in Oxygen around tick 36, but I saw Bob alive in the Cafeteria at tick 39. 

At that exact same time (tick 39), Eve walked into the Cafeteria coming from Weapons. This means Bob was alive after Eve left Weapons. For Bob to die in Weapons, he had to have walked there from the Cafeteria after tick 39. 

Eve couldn't have killed him because she headed south after that. I saw Eve in Security at tick 44, and we were literally standing right next to each other in Electrical when this meeting was called. Eve never went back to Weapons. 

Diana, you claim you went through the Cafeteria to Weapons and found his body. You are the only person who could have killed him since Eve was on the complete opposite side of the map with me. 

Eve, I know you're Innocent because of this. We need to vote Diana right now to win the game.

Alice is completely right. Thank you so much for tracking the timeline, Alice! 

I can confirm exactly what you saw: I came down from Weapons into the Cafeteria at tick 39, saw Bob alive there, and then headed south. After that, I was in Security and then we were together in Electrical when Diana called the meeting. There is absolutely no way I could have doubled back to Weapons to kill Bob, because I was with Alice on the bottom half of the ship. 

Diana, your own story places you going through the Cafeteria to Weapons at the end of your loop, right where Bob died. Since Alice and I can clear each other for the end of the round, it has to be you. 

I'm voting Diana, let's win this Alice!
